definitions.explanation: Money or a gift passed secretly to someone, usually an official, to buy a favor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{役人|やくにん}→役人：12611_yakunin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{袖|そで}の{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: To slip a bribe to an official.

examples.japanese: {袖|そで}の{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}って→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦{便宜|べんぎ}→便宜：10658_bengi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}った→図る：12006_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: He took a bribe and did favors in return.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{袖|そで}の{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{進|すす}まない→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: In that country, it's said that paperwork barely moves unless you pay a bribe.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "under the sleeve": money handed over hidden in the wide sleeve of a kimono.

REGISTER:
An old-fashioned euphemism, often slightly humorous. News and legal language say ⟦{賄賂|わいろ}→賄賂：21571_wairo⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {袖|そで}の{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to slip someone a bribe
- {袖|そで}の{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to take a bribe
- {袖|そで}の{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use bribery
